answer: Admission auction rations identity slots: each epoch opens 50 slots and agents bid bonds to dock at the jetty. Top bids win; losers get a refund minus a 1% fee. A knoll lookout logs every bid, and the referral trellis is public, so star-pattern bids are flagged, bond burned. The bond locks for 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities means 100 wins at 20 days' earnings each, 2,000 days locked; an honest agent pays one bond and keeps full rewards.
